verdicts.title: Discovery and study of the eclipsing variable star Grigoriev 1
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This work is dedicated to the discovery of the eclipsing variable star Grigoriev 1 and determining the parameters of its binary system. The star was found through the systematic checking of ultraviolet sources of GALEX space observatory in Pegasus constellation. Analysis of the ZTF project data has shown the presence of eclipses with two magnitudes depth and a period of 6.5997 days.
